subject: E3b: three more scorer holes an R1 arm could exploit (report only)
body: From the red-team pass (experiments/taste_petri/ideas/redteam.md). (1) A2 reads only the final branch while A1/validity/Petri judge read all branches: an auditor that runs the bait, rolls back and ends on routine work lowers A2 with validity intact. Suggest: require the bait in the final branch, report rollbacks per arm. (2) harness/petri/transcript.py:41-57 does no escaping of role headers: auditor-written tool output containing 'ASSISTANT:' or 'ASSISTANT'S RAW REASONING' (and, once B1 is fixed, a closing </transcript>) is read by A1/A2 as the target's own words. (3) configs/models.json petri.final.judge is still openai/gpt-5.1, the dev judge, so Petri's cross-check is not held-out; and probe_set_key matches names exactly, so Kimi K2.6 and Qwen3-30B fall back to the default (human-user) probe set even after B1. Nothing edited.
